description_expanded: OverviewSEACREST BEACH – Sunshine Shack Steps to Rosemary Beach | Community Pool | Sleeps 12 DESCRIPTION The Sunshine Shack is a professionally decorated, three-story retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach. Ideally located at the front of the neighborhood, this home is just steps to Seacrest’s shops, restaurants, and the 12,000 sq ft resort-style community pool. Rosemary Beach is just next door, making this the perfect spot for families looking to enjoy all that 30A has to offer. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Relax on wrap-around porches, swing on the porch swing, or fire up the large stainless-steel grill for family cookouts. The private landscaped backyard backs onto a quiet bike path, while an outdoor hot/cold shower with a rainwater showerhead is perfect for rinsing off after the beach. The home is just across 30A from the sugar-white sands, with a complimentary on-call tram service to make beach trips easy and convenient. HOME FEATURES 5 bedrooms | 4 bathrooms | Sleeps 12 Access to Seacrest’s 12,000 sq ft lagoon-style community pool Wrap-around porches with outdoor seating and porch swing Fully stocked kitchen with stainless steel appliances & granite countertops Wall-mounted flat-screen TVs in every room Xbox 360, toys, and games for kids Large gas grill + outdoor hot/cold shower Pack-N-Play crib provided for families DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Steps to shops and dining in Seacrest Beach Steps to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach for boutiques, restaurants, and family activities Access to 30A’s scenic bike path right behind the home SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS 1st Floor: King bedroom with private bath 2nd Floor: King primary suite with spa tub + natural stone shower 2nd Floor: Queen bedroom with shared bath 2nd Floor: Bunk room with 2 twin bunk sets (sleeps 4) with shared bath 3rd Floor: Tower bedroom with twin daybed + trundle, kids’ retreat with beverage fridge, Xbox, toys and more Living Room: Sectional sofa with queen pullout bed WHY STAY HERE? One of the closest homes to Rosemary Beach Professionally decorated, spacious, and family-friendly Access to Seacrest’s stunning community pool and easy beach tram service Outdoor shower, beach toys, and everything you need for a carefree beach vacation The Sunshine Shack combines coastal charm, convenience, and fun — the perfect Seacrest Beach getaway for your next family vacation.Show less
